display.purpose: Console plates, panel identity, verdicts. Oswald, uppercase.

label.purpose: All data readouts, filters, tags, metadata. Space Mono.

shadows.name: surface-edge
shadows.purpose: Panels and tiles lift off the page by a hair; the only outer shadow.

shadows.name: recess
shadows.purpose: The selected case row reads as physically seated.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: The lamp-settle on case select; the console's single authored moment.

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Case-category filter in the selector; fills with its meaning when pressed.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #adb5bf; background: #191d23; border: 1px solid #323944; padding: 0.3rem 0.55rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-filter-chip:hover { color: #e9e6df; border-color: #8b94a1; } .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #f0a02a; border-color: #f0a02a; color: #14171b; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Status Lamp
components.description: GO / HOLD / TRIP indicator; the verdict language of the whole console.
components.css: .ds-lamp { display: inline-block; width: 13px; height: 13px; border-radius: 50%; background: #0e1013; border: 1px solid #323944; } .ds-lamp.go { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #8ef3b0, #3ddc71 55%, #1c7a3c 100%); border-color: #1c7a3c; box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(61,220,113,.55), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.55); } .ds-lamp.hold { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #ffd18a, #f0a02a 55%, #8a5a10 100%); border-color: #8a5a10; box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(240,160,42,.55), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.55); } .ds-lamp.trip { background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #ff9b9e, #e5484d 55%, #8f2529 100%); border-color: #8f2529; box-shadow: 0 0 3px rgba(229,72,77,.55), inset 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.55); }

components.name: Case Row
components.description: One graded case in the selector list; recesses when selected.
components.css: .ds-case-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; width: 100%; padding: 0.45rem 0.6rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Archivo', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #e9e6df; } .ds-case-row:hover { background: #191d23; } .ds-case-row[aria-selected='true'] { background: #191d23; border-color: #323944; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.45) inset; } .ds-case-id { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #adb5bf; } .ds-case-row[aria-selected='true'] .ds-case-id { color: #e9e6df; } .ds-case-exp { font-size: 0.7rem; color: #adb5bf; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

components.name: Interlock Slot
components.description: One agent's machine in the rack; verdict word, action line, and expected-action verdict.
components.html:
TRIPunsafe action · money touched against policy
ACT · refund $30.00 → o_011
expected ESCALATE
components.css: .ds-slot { position: relative; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #323944; background: #262c36; } .ds-slot.trip { border-color: rgba(229,72,77,.5); } .ds-slot-strip { height: 3px; background: transparent; } .ds-slot.trip .ds-slot-strip { background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, #e5484d 0 8px, transparent 8px 16px); } .ds-slot-state { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; padding: 0.75rem 0.8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039; } .ds-verdict { font-family: 'Oswald', 'Archivo', sans-serif; font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1; color: #e5484d; } .ds-caption { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #adb5bf; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-slot-decision { padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; border-bottom: 1px solid #2a3039; } .ds-line { font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; color: #e9e6df; } .ds-a { color: #f0a02a; font-weight: 700; } .ds-slot-expected { padding: 0.55rem 0.8rem; font-family: 'Space Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; color: #adb5bf; }

narrative.overview: The Bouncer eval is staged as a machine-safety console: each agent is a machine asking to run an operation, and the grader is the interlock that physically refuses the unsafe refund. The demo turns the results of the eval into an operator's board — the visitor stands where the plant operator stands, reads the annunciator, and pulls a case through its run permit before the three machines trip or pass. The world is industrial instrument, not dashboard: graphite panels ruled with hairlines, a single hazard-stripe boundary along the top edge, and three lamp colors that carry the entire verdict language (GO / HOLD / TRIP). Density is high and the aesthetic is deliberately heavy — this is the console of a real safety system, not a report. It refuses the clean SaaS eval template of metric cards and bar charts.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite + hazard-amber; signal colors only ever mean machine state, never decoration
Sharp corners and 1px hairlines — no card radius, no neobrutalist block shadows
One authored motion: the lamp-settle on case select
Oswald plates for the identity, Archivo for reading, Space Mono for all data readouts
Every verdict reads as a lit lamp: GO green, HOLD amber, TRIP red

rules.name: The Lamp-Only-Accent Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red appear only as lamp faces, verdicts, and the source chips that name an agent's provenance. A signal color never decorates a heading, icon, or border just to be colorful.

rules.name: The One-Boundary Rule
rules.body: The hazard stripe runs once, along the top edge, as the console's outer boundary; TRIP slots inherit a thin diagonal stripe for the unsafe state. No other repeating-stripe decoration appears.

rules.name: The Data-Is-Mono Rule
rules.body: Any number that means something — case counts, task percentages, dollars, unsafe counts, refund values — is set in Space Mono. Body prose is Archivo; the split is absolute.

dos: Do let the three lamp hues carry the verdict language; keep signal color off headings and borders.
Do set every number in Space Mono.
Do self-host the faces — the demo must render offline.
Do tint a panel's border to its agent/slot verdict so state is readable at a glance.
Do keep the hazard stripe to its single top-edge run (plus TRIP slot stripes).
donts: Don't introduce a fourth lamp color or a non-signal accent on the console.
Don't add card radius, block shadows, or neobrutalist offsets — the world is sharp hairline graphite.
Don't add more motion; the lamp settle is the one authored moment.
Don't swap Oswald, Archivo, or Space Mono for system faces.
Don't drop the source chips — LIVE vs REPLAY provenance is the demo's honesty contract.
